comment: Daman UniverseRegistry on Arc testnet. Addresses populated by `forge script script/DeployUniverse.s.sol` after the Safe + Timelock land on-chain. The DamanCopyBond constructor reads the UniverseRegistry proxy address from this file (or its env mirror) for the asset-eligibility gate.

safe.comment: Independent of the copy-bond Safe per the brief's recommendation: a compromised copy-bond Safe cannot upgrade the universe registry and vice versa.
